Software development, coding assistants and developer tools.

Physical devices, electronics, components and do-it-yourself hardware builds.
Human conversation, interpersonal communication and the social dynamics of talking with others.
Human health, clinical conditions, treatments and medical research.
Cultural trends, social change, media consumption and public discourse.
Historical events, documents, archives and their interpretation.
Planets, celestial bodies, orbital dynamics and observational sky surveys.

Quantum mechanics experiments, entanglement, and foundational physics research.

Agents that revise their own prompts, harnesses, skills, workflows or policies over time, including recursive self-improvement, and the safety and evaluation limits of automated self-modification.
Preservation of websites and born-digital web content through crawls, archives and searchable collections, including efforts to keep defunct services such as GeoCities accessible.
Government affairs, political appointments, public officials, elections and political debate.
Amateur radio operation, RF equipment and spectrum regulation, including ham-band transceivers, software-defined radio, licensing rules and marketplace restrictions on radio gear.
Debt issuance, credit ratings, capital raising and the financial structure of AI companies and their infrastructure buildout.
Personal finance apps and methods for tracking accounts, spending and budgets, and for forecasting household cash flow.
Emergency call routing and dispatch, civilian crisis-response programs, and the division of labor between police, fire, medical and other first responders.
Game engine architecture, frameworks and source-code releases used to build and run video games.
Non-native plants, animals and other organisms that spread beyond their original range and harm ecosystems, agriculture or public health, and efforts to control them.
Cloud computing services and platforms, including reliance on remote providers, vendor lock-in and the trade-offs between hosted software and local control.
